title: Card design: standard picture sizes, customer type colours, MARKET/CUSTOMER tags, cleaner backs (print kit and app)
problem: The owner's list for the print kit: picture boxes differ in size between cards; customer types are not told apart at a glance; event cards do not show clearly whether a price change is at the Wholesale Market or from customers; backs carry "Deck of N"; the shopkeeper footer says "Your perk all game".
scope: Customer cards: one picture size, fruit and tags laid out to fit; top and bottom bars coloured by type (Premium deep purple with gold edge, Everyday teal, Bargain warm orange)
Guest and event cards: one picture size each; event effect boxes one size; MARKET (lorry, grey) and CUSTOMER (customer face) tags on money lines
Shopkeeper footer "Fruit Market", centred; no "Deck of N" on any back
The same design in the app and the print kit; print kit and update pack rebuilt
exclusions: Any rule, number or card meaning change

acceptance.text: npm run verify passes; print kit tests pass
acceptance.evidence: npm run verify on the merge 80f7d46: 942 tests passed, 1 skipped; card tests pin the badge per event from the data, one-line titles, the guest sentences, same-size boxes; print kit rebuilt and its checker passed every card.
The helper's npm run test:e2e on 5b4904a (after the owner's review): PASS, speed test OK, 0 leaks, quick match, four players, reconnect.
